title: Fix 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add questions' error on Admin Panel

requirements.summary: Remove the 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add questions' error banner from AdminPanelScreen and ensure the Add Question form and Questions list are fully visible and functional after entering the correct password
acceptanceCriteria: After entering the correct password 'Naeem9472', the Add Question form is visible with no unauthorized error banner.
The 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add questions' red error message is never shown.
The Questions list loads and displays backend questions without any unauthorized error.
The password gate still prevents access before the correct password is entered.

file_operations.description: Remove any frontend-side error display, conditional render, or access check that shows the 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add questions' message. Remove any role-based checks that hide the Add Question form or Questions list. Ensure the password gate (password: 'Naeem9472') remains as the only authentication mechanism. After the correct password is entered, both the Add Question form and the Questions list must be fully visible with no unauthorized error banner displayed. Remove any error state handling that displays authorization-related errors from backend calls.

Review and remove any error handling logic that displays or propagates 'Unauthorized' errors from the addQuestion or getAdminQuestions backend calls. Ensure mutations and queries do not surface authorization errors to the UI. The hooks should handle backend responses gracefully without triggering unauthorized error displays.
